title: Code review and safe change 6
description: Use src/allocator.c to identify a bounded change, its callers, and a testable acceptance condition. Do not infer unobserved behavior.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in src/allocator.c, src/allocator.h, src/main.c.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for src/allocator.c, src/allocator.h, src/main.c
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
